# Theory: Engines Differ in UX and Ecosystem, Not in Pull-vs-Push Physics

Flux, Argo CD, Jenkins X, Spinnaker, Tekton occupy different UI and CD-vs-CI mixes. The GitOps physics (reconcile desired from Git) is shared with Flux.

## Invariants

1. Argo CD is application-centric UI + multi-cluster.
2. Flux is Kubernetes-API-centric, GitOps Toolkit CRDs.
3. Spinnaker is pipeline-centric, heavier.

```text
CI (build)     CD (converge cluster)
Tekton/Jenkins    Argo CD / Flux / Spinnaker
```

## What can break

- Running two reconcilers on the same objects.

## How to read this chapter

Comparisons, choosing an engine.
